up: Retrieve all molecules that are associated with the document having ChEMBL ID CHEMBL5390237. For each molecule, provide its ChEMBL ID, its preferred name (pref_name), its maximum development phase (max_phase), its molecule type (molecule_type), and its canonical SMILES (if available). Order the resulting list by the molecule's ChEMBL ID in ascending order.
sql: SELECT DISTINCT md.chembl_id AS molecule_chembl_id, md.pref_name, md.max_phase, md.molecule_type, cs.canonical_smiles FROM docs JOIN compound_records ON docs.doc_id = compound_records.doc_id JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON compound_records.molregno = md.molregno LEFT JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE docs.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL5390237' ORDER BY md.chembl_id ASC;
